title: your DNA is a superconductor
subtitle: programming reality — the Cassiopaean claim meets modern physics
continuity_object: DNA helix transforming into an antenna

scenes.title: The standard story
scenes.narration: DNA codes proteins. Proteins build the body. The body houses consciousness.

scenes.title: What's missing
scenes.narration: This story leaves out something essential: DNA conducts electricity.

scenes.title: Charge transport
scenes.narration: In the 1990s, researchers discovered that electrons move through DNA's stacked base pairs.

scenes.title: Molecular wire
scenes.narration: DNA can act as a conductor, semiconductor, or insulator depending on its environment.

scenes.title: The Cassiopaean claim
scenes.narration: In 1994, a channeled source stated that DNA is a superconductor — a neurotransceiver for consciousness.

scenes.title: Not just a blueprint
scenes.narration: DNA, they said, is 'the method used for creation and maintenance of program illusions.'

scenes.title: Neurotransceiver
scenes.narration: Receiving and transmitting — DNA as an antenna between consciousness and the physical world.

scenes.title: Thought pattern programs
scenes.narration: Electromagnetic wave transmission facilitates thought patterns through the DNA infrastructure.

scenes.title: The program illusion
scenes.narration: 'That perception is part of the illusion. What you perceive as solid is a program readout.'

scenes.title: Perception is programmed
scenes.narration: The Cassiopaeans: your perception of linear time is maintained by how DNA interacts with electromagnetic fields.

scenes.title: Linear time
scenes.narration: If DNA is a clock, what is it measuring? And what if the clock is also the clockmaker?

scenes.title: Simultaneity
scenes.narration: All time is now. Sequence is a readout — not a fundamental feature of reality.

scenes.title: Modern convergence
scenes.narration: Michael Levin's lab shows that bioelectric fields carry pattern information across cellular networks.

scenes.title: The field
scenes.narration: Cells communicate electrically. DNA is part of a larger bioelectric field that navigates morphospace.

scenes.title: Levin bridge
scenes.narration: Levin: 'The bioelectric field is the hardware of the body's memory.' The Cassiopaeans: 'DNA is a superconductor.'

scenes.title: Osiris
scenes.narration: The cutting up of Osiris' body represents the reduction of human knowledge capacity — the removal of frequencies from DNA.

scenes.title: The myth encodes
scenes.narration: Ancient knowledge encoded as myth: the fall was a reduction in the number of accessible DNA strands.

scenes.title: The upgrade
scenes.narration: 'You don't get added strands. You receive. Interaction with the upcoming wave, if vibration is aligned.'

scenes.title: Alignment
scenes.narration: The Wave is coming. Your DNA must be tuned to receive it. Knowledge protects.

scenes.title: Caution
scenes.narration: DNA charge transport is real. DNA as a superconductor is not established. The boundary matters.

scenes.title: The distinction
scenes.narration: The Cassiopaean claim is extraordinary. But extraordinary claims require disciplined scrutiny.

scenes.title: Closing
scenes.narration: Your DNA is not a blueprint. It is an antenna. The program is running — and you are the programmer.

scenes.title: Final frame
scenes.narration: You don't get. You receive. The Wave is here. Align your vibration.
